text:
twitter/phone minimalism (WIP)

ideally weekends + weds (3 days/wk)

-goal: as close to 0 mins screen time daily as possible

-do all writing/composing either in drafts (if on desktop) or iPhone notes (if mobile/airplane mode)

-mkts/newsflow: create a list that’s just zerohedge + walter bloomberg. if a headline moves the mkt one of them will usually catch it. if not, u get what u pay for. 

-do not deviate from this tab. stay off the for you tab, it’s where time goes to die

-DM's: [probably should be "no" but I check several times a day if there's q's]

-turn off iPhone notifications for X (and everything possible)

-log on 1x or 2x a day and send ur drafts/composed tweets.  [mine end up super long doing this, I'm not sure if its good or bad. WIP]

-“will that hurt my engagement?” - bro if ur a grown man sweating ur social media engagement, u have much bigger problems than ur Screen Time

--

whats the point of all this screen time minimization?

make sure ur relationships are healthy (God/family/friends)

and then use all the free time to:
1. read more books
2. write more longform

minimal means minimal

the good life is really just simplicity and serenity

and "it is not happiness that man seeks...but peace."

so have some goddamn self-discipline, would ya

hth
—GB Kondo
